positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "Irresponsible spending over the last two years has placed our economy in a precarious position – and President Biden and Congressional Democrats are avoiding negotiations to address the debt and deficits. @HouseGOP will pass the Limit, Save, Grow Act as a responsible solution."
"The left is all about spending taxpayer money on their socialist agenda. The American people are paying the freight for their reckless behavior."
Voted against HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "I'm heading to the @HouseFloor to manage the rule on 2 housing bills that will create 1000s of new constructions jobs & boost the economy."
"I had a great discussionthis morning with Dallas City Council members about continuing our strategic partnership, funding for important housing program, and bolstering our N.TX infrastructure."

"I was proud to support the Military Construction and VA appropriations bill which will enable the @DeptVetAffairs to treat over seven million more #Veterans this upcoming year and help provide housing for 1.4 million active duty military families."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Today, I spoke with Chairman Powell in a @FinancialCmte hearing. Dems continue to make friends with inflation, blame it on business, and encourage it with wasteful spending. It's simple, stop inflation by lowering taxes, regulating less, and leading Americans back to work!"
"What's the result of Democrats' 2-year-long, 3.5 TRILLION dollar spending spree? 40-year high inflation, which has outpaced wages for 21 straight months."
Voted against HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Biden's student loan forgiveness plan is UNCONSTITUTIONAL and will further bankrupt our country."

"During COVID-19, self-certification was a leading cause of fraud in government programs. Now, Biden is proposing to allow student loan forgiveness applicants to self-certify. The Biden Admin should take greater precautions when using the American taxpayer's hard-earned money."
"The President finally recognized what a majority of Americans already knew, the COVID pandemic is over! He has no basis to forgive $500 BILLION in student loan debt via executive order."
"Today’s SCOTUS ruling is clear– The Dept. of Education’s authority under statute does not allow Biden to defy Congressional intent and create a new student loan forgiveness program from scratch."

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

"I am voting no to H.R. 1 because it...undermines current voter ID laws"

Reliable energy sources allow the entrepreneurial spirit of Texans to thrive and promotes freedom from unstable regions often hostile to the values of America. positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "After three years of urging the Biden Admin to regain operational control of the southern border, time has run out. The Biden border crisis has devolved into complete chaos. Congress must prioritize America's own border before moving to consider funding elsewhere."
"As a Texan running for Speaker, no other candidate will work harder to solve our crisis on the southern border. We must support federal law enforcement and restore America’s Rule of Law."

"Biden's lax border policies are leading to RECORD ILLEGAL MIGRATION on the southern border. Yesterday in Eagle Pass, TX, border enforcement urged me and my colleagues to make SERIOUS CHANGES, or the crisis will only worsen. Congress must pass meaningful border policy changes."
Rated 96% by NumbersUSA
